title: Ramadan Quiz
description: Answer questions and learn something new.
howToPlay: Tap the answer you think is right.
Read why the answer is right, then tap Next.

title: Match the Words
description: Match Ramadan words to their pictures.
howToPlay: Then tap the picture that goes with it.

title: Find the Missing Lantern
description: Look carefully — which lantern went missing?
howToPlay: Look at the lanterns. Take as long as you like.
One lantern has gone! Tap the lantern that is missing.

title: Mosque Puzzle
description: Put the picture of the village mosque back together.
howToPlay: Then tap another piece to swap them.
Keep swapping until the picture is complete.

title: Sort the Good Deeds
description: Is it a kind choice, or could we choose better?

title: Ramadan Memory Cards
description: Flip the cards and find the matching pairs.
howToPlay: Tap a card to flip it.
If they match, they stay open. Find all the pairs!

title: Word Meanings
description: Match each Islamic word to its meaning.
howToPlay: Learn a new word each time!
